name: ERCC excision repair 6, chromatin remodeling factor

function.text: ERCC6 encodes chimeric ERCC6-PGBD3 protein. Annotated molecular activities include sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA repair and positive regulation of gene expression.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Cockayne spectrum with or without cerebrooculofacioskeletal syndrome (autosomal recessive); Cockayne syndrome type 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
